subject: *: update tikv/client-go (#47074)
summary: This commit only bumps `github.com/tikv/client-go/v2` (f9e28714c62c -> be2b4c78a910) plus matching Bazel DEPS metadata, and relaxes a realtikv stale-read `rpc_num` assertion to allow an extra retry. Review of the client-go delta shows the only behavioral changes are tighter/safer DeadlineExceeded classification (incl. gRPC status code) and limiting the “configurable read timeout” fast-retry path to read RPC types; no Blocker/High correctness, consistency, transaction/session, or protocol-handling regression is evident from the diff.
